source-parity.source: Slow ships equal -50 values for normal, Sneak and Invisibility movement records, plus its separate force and ballistic modifiers. The paired archived retail Crippling Shot packets pin the signed stat-115 /100 projection and its addition to an existing movement scale. PR775 showed the stock renderer did not slow from record delivery alone.
source-parity.runtime: TimedEffects publishes the effective signed scale to the affected owner's view and observers, composes it with Movement Accelerator and restores the remaining scale on expiry. PR779 verifies the original-target cast and duration behaviour. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/779#issuecomment-7083574032
